scope: Code-only boundary tests. Controlled positive grammar and trusted allowed records; adapter rebuilds canonical host audience view. Only resolved read/explain compiles v0.1 programs and runs existing kernel then release-validating realizer. Unresolved has no text; no Ask argument/path and no Compare. No experiment runner/data/model dependency, training, GPU, spend, network or capability claim. No shared schema/kernel/realizer changes.
semantic_guard: Each admitted form returns requested_kind/requested_field. Model disagreement and duplicate case-folded field surfaces fail closed before kernel/renderer. No model choice is silently corrected.
temporal_guard: The same four dated forms return requested_scope YYYY-MM. Every bound selected field must exist and match that exact temporal_scope before program construction. Missing/stale scopes abstain without kernel/renderer. Undated forms use active host-context scope. No broader date grammar or Compare support.
